Every figure is read from the source document named in methodology-uri. Scope caveats: Calendar year 2024, the Commission's EMAS-registered sites (Brussels, Luxembourg, the JRC sites Petten, Geel, Seville, Karlsruhe and Ispra, Grange, the Houses of Europe) plus staff missions from other sites. carbon-footprint is the table's printed sum (162,026 tCO2e); the three scope figures are as printed and add to 162,027 because of rounding in the source. Scope 3 includes embodied emissions of buildings, IT and furniture, teleworking and experts' travel. The headline table does not label the Scope 2 method, so carbon-accounting is omitted. energy-consumption is the Commission's final energy consumption at the EMAS sites (Table 4.1).
